Item 1. Business

Acme Industrial Corp designs, manufactures, and services engineered machinery. TOC-SENTINEL-BUSINESS marks the real Business section body in this fixture.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

TOC-SENTINEL-RISK marks the real Risk Factors body. Our results depend heavily on capital spending by a small number of large logistics customers, and a deferral of automation projects by any one of them would materially reduce our order backlog.

We rely on a limited number of suppliers for precision motion components. Extended lead times have in the past delayed shipments, and a recurrence could increase costs and delay revenue recognition into later periods.
